WebGPUAudioDownmixAlgorithmHelp: Used by the WebGPU player only when the audio destination cannot present the complete 5.1 or 7.1 speaker layout.
WebGPUAudioDownmixStatusLive: Downmix gains applied live and saved for the active WebGPU stereo downmix.
WebGPUAudioDownmixStatusPending: Saved. No active compatible WebGPU stereo downmix accepted the live gain change; the gains will apply to the next compatible client-decoded downmix.
WebGPUAudioLayoutStatusApplying: Switching the active WebGPU client-decoded audio...
WebGPUAudioLayoutStatusLive: Applied to the active WebGPU client-decoded audio; audio pauses briefly while it switches.
WebGPUAudioLayoutStatusPending: No active WebGPU client-decoded audio; it applies to the next client-decoded playback.
WebGPUAudioOutputDescription: System default follows operating-system output changes. Already permitted outputs can be selected directly; Choose output requests browser access when that API is available.
WebGPUAudioOutputPickerUnavailable: This browser does not expose the audio output picker
WebGPUAudioOutputPickerUnavailableHelp: The browser output picker is unavailable; already permitted outputs remain usable.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusDefaultActive: Using the system default audio output.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusDefaultEnumeratio: Available outputs could not be refreshed; playback remains on the system default output.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusDefaultFallback: The system default could not be applied; using one permitted fallback.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusDefaultSaved: The system default audio output is saved for the next active playback path.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusPickerCancelled: Audio output selection was cancelled. Playback output was not changed.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusPickerFailed: The browser could not choose an audio output. Playback output was not changed.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusPickerInvalidDevi: The browser returned an invalid audio output device.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusPickerNotAllowed: Audio output selection is blocked by browser permission or policy.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusPickerNotFound: No audio output device is currently available.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusPickerUnavailable: This browser cannot authorize additional audio outputs. Already permitted outputs can still be selected.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusPickerUserActionR: Choose output must be opened directly from a user action.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusRouteFailed: The requested audio output could not be applied. Playback remains on its current or system-default output.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusSelectedEnumerati: Available outputs could not be refreshed; the selected output remains active and will be retried for new playback paths.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusSelectedFallback: The selected output could not be applied to every active audio path; using a safe fallback.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusSelectedSaved: The selected audio output is saved for the next active playback path.
WebGPUAudioOutputStatusSelectedUnavailab: The saved output is unavailable; using the system default. It will be restored when available.
The saved output and system default are unavailable; using one permitted fallback. The saved output will still be retried.
WebGPUAudioSettingsApplyHelp: Downmix gain changes apply live to an active compatible WebGPU stereo downmix. Force stereo and downmix algorithm changes switch active client-decoded audio in place, with a brief pause in sound.
WebGPUAuthorizeAudioOutput: Authorize an audio output through the browser
WebGPUBrightnessHelp: Adds or removes display brightness after tone mapping.
WebGPUCenterLevelHelp: Scales the center channel contribution; values above 1 boost it.
WebGPUContrastHelp: Scales display contrast after tone mapping.
WebGPUDownmixGainsHelp: Values above 1 amplify the selected contribution. Boosted multichannel stereo downmixes are peak-limited; the selected WebGPU downmix algorithm still controls the base matrix. Native-media audio and HTML fallback playback do not consume these settings.
WebGPUDownmixOutputGainHelp: Boosts the completed stereo downmix before peak limiting.
WebGPUEnableCustomDecodeHelp: The player demuxes and decodes direct-play sources itself, with WebCodecs first and your decoder packages only where WebCodecs cannot decode. When off, it plays only what the browser plays natively, the server transcodes everything else, and HDR tone mapping is unavailable.
WebGPUEnableHDRToneMappingHelp: The player requests HDR and Dolby Vision video from the server and tone maps it with WebGPU, using the settings below. When off, HDR plays natively where the browser supports it, and the server transcodes it to SDR otherwise. Requires custom decode.
WebGPUForceStereo: Force stereo for WebGPU client-decoded audio
WebGPUForceStereoHelp: Otherwise complete client-decoded 5.1 or 7.1 audio can use a matching native speaker output.
WebGPUHighlightDesaturationHelp: Reduces saturation near the brightest mapped values.
WebGPUManualInputPeakHelp: Manual HDR source peak used when metadata tracking is off.
WebGPUOutputPeakHelp: Peak luminance of the SDR output transform.
WebGPUPaperWhiteHelp: Reference white used by the HDR-to-SDR transform.
WebGPUPlaybackChangesRestartRequired: Playback changes are restart-required and apply after restarting playback or starting the next item.
WebGPUPlaybackChangesSavedStatus: Saved. Playback changes are restart-required and apply after restarting playback or starting the next item.
WebGPUPreferredVideoPlayerHelp: Selects the local player when a new video starts. The WebGPU player automatically falls back to HTML if its presentation or custom decoding path fails.
WebGPURedetectAudioOutputHelp: Re-read the current output device and switch active audio to its speaker layout
WebGPURenderStatusInactive: Saved. Controls apply when an HDR-to-SDR WebGPU presentation is active.
WebGPURenderStatusPeakUnavailable: Saved. The detected source peak is unavailable; automatic tracking will apply to the next HDR presentation.
WebGPURenderStatusPending: Saved. The current presentation could not apply the change; it will apply to the next HDR presentation.
WebGPUSaturationHelp: Scales display saturation after tone mapping.
WebGPUSurroundLevelHelp: Scales back and side channel contributions; values above 1 boost them.
WebGPUTrackSourcePeakMetadataHelp: When enabled, valid stream metadata replaces the manual input peak.
WebGPUHDROutputHelp: Shows HDR video as HDR, mapped to the output peak and paper white set above, instead of tone mapping it to SDR. SDR video and SDR displays are unaffected.
WebGPUHDROutputApplied: HDR output saved. It applies to HDR video on an HDR display.
WebGPUHDROutputFailed: HDR output could not be applied: {0}
WebGPUShaderPassesHelp: WGSL shader passes run in the order listed, in this browser only. A file of several passes runs them in file order.
WebGPUShaderPassesFailed: The shader passes could not be applied: {0}
WebGPUShaderPassesStorageFailed: The shader files could not be stored: {0}
WebGPUSettingsSaveFailed: The settings could not be saved in this browser: {0}
WebGPUShaderPassFilesSkipped: Not added: {0}. A preset holds at most {1} files of at most {2} characters each.
WebGPUShaderPassParameterPending: Saved. It applies once the pass runs ({0}).
WebGPUServerPassesNone: The server offers no other passes.
WebGPUServerPassAdded: {0} downloaded from the server and added.
WebGPUShaderPassWithdrawn: From the server: {0}, which no longer offers it
WebGPUServerDecoders: The server offers {0}; each downloads when a playback needs it.
WebGPUDecoderPackagesHelp: A decoder package is one .wasm file that adds a video or audio decoder in this browser only, or replaces the server's package of its id. Your packages come first, and they may play without test vectors, so add only packages you trust. Changes apply from the next playback.
WebGPUDecoderPackageUnusable: Unusable, so playback leaves it out: {0}
WebGPUDecoderPackagesStorageFailed: The decoder packages could not be read or stored: {0}
